prompt:
Mobile clients retry `POST /orders/{id}/pay` when the network drops, sending the same
`Idempotency-Key` header on every attempt. Often the first attempt actually went
through server-side, so the retry gets

    409 {"error": {"code": "conflict", "message": "order ord_0003 is not awaiting payment (paid)"}}

and the app tells the customer the payment failed even though the card was charged.
A retry carrying the same key should get the original payment back (200, same payment
id) without charging again or sending a second receipt. Reusing a key for a *different*
order must still be refused.
